Name: Express Cooking
Author: PixelatorGadzy
Description:
If you've ever used the Readers Digest mod, this is basically just the Cooking part of it. This mod seeks to send the recipes that Queen of Sauce provides to the user in the mail for in case you forget to check the TV or that it even exists or for the people who find checking the TV tedious and out of the way.

Currently the mail is only readable in English as I have no idea how to do the translation stuff as I've never modded before this. (presumably it still works regardless of language? I make no promises) I only made this mod because Readers Digest isn't up to date plus me and the person I play SDV with find getting the Queen of Sauce Recipes shipped to us really convenient. I don't know if anyone else has already done this or not, but I'll leave this up until I am told it's redundant.

Downloads.Description: The mod that has all of the Queen of Sauce shows put into mail

Manifest.Name: (MFM) Express Cooking
Manifest.Description: Seeks to Ship The Queen of Sauce Recipes to those that forget to check the TV.
